result.title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
result.summary: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PIVOT，用教师模型评估的序列困惑度作为样本级信号，在 on-policy distillation 与 GRPO 之间动态路由样本，以替代全局固定的 KD→RL 切换调度，并在 Banking77、HWU64 少样本文本分类上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 以困惑度/不确定性逐样本决定「继续教师引导」还是「转入奖励精炼」的调度线索，可能可供核查是否迁移到 LVR 中依据置信度决定 latent 思考长度与停止（STOP）时机；但该工作为纯文本分类训练期调度，无视觉状态与 latent 生成，相关性需人工判断。
